notes: Accepted stages require both product success and independent audit success.
Maximum concurrent jobs in snapshots is the local controller limit, not a measured number of simultaneous scheduler allocations.
Scheduler completion alone is not acceptance. Terminal rejections and unsubmitted downstream stages are listed separately.
Historical rejections can overlap a later accepted recheck; they are not added to the accepted count.
Status snapshots may precede the audit. Their timestamps are retained.
Transport control uses a sleep job, not VASP. Its cancellation tests the controller only.
Private evidence is retained locally and identified by hash; it is not distributed. No POTCAR or cluster configuration is included.
